ops.text: Upgrade both formulae/casks. Watch for any macOS consent prompt. On the FIRST upgrade onto the fix, at most one final identity-change prompt per service is expected and acceptable (approve it — it's the last). cookiesync on this Mac also crosses the 0.15.0 keyhelper→authkit migration (see cookiesync CHANGELOG: brew uninstall --cask cookiesync-keyhelper && brew install --cask authkit if not auto-resolved).
ops.command: brew update && brew upgrade cc-pool cookiesync
